messages:
devon: Heads-up — a scheduled NA aggregate recompute (job id rb-0xa9) detected a high duplicate_key_fraction in the pre-commit scan. Might be late-event replays creating id collisions. Want a quick design for console + runbook before we touch prod. :thinking_face:

lena: how high is "high"? and is it real duplicates or duplicate write attempts?

devon: scan: duplicate_key_fraction = 0.045 (4.5%), total_keys = 12.3M. Most dupes clustered in user segment u-10..u-14.

replay-bot: job rb-0xa9 status: PREPARED
  precommit_scan: DONE
  duplicate_key_fraction: 0.045
  duplicates_sample: 120/120 checked -> pattern: late-event with new session_id colliding on upsert

priya: 4.5% is non-trivial for billing-sensitive metrics. If we apply the backfill naively we'll inflate active_user counts. Need a dedupe pass or a reconciliation layer.

sahil: console needs a clear "duplication risk" indicator and a diff-preview so PMs can see the delta before/after. Also a throttle that prevents auto-apply when dupes > 1%.

lena: UX idea: add a small preview tile that shows: preview_delta_pct and example rows (collapsed) with before/after. Also have a big red banner if duplicate_key_fraction > 0.02 with an "inspect" CTA.

priya: API request: add job_metadata.dedupe_mode boolean or enum? We need values: none | dry-run | auto-apply. default for scheduled telemetry backfills should be dry-run.

devon: agree on enum. Suggest job_metadata.dedupe_mode = "dry-run" default. We should also store a ledger entry for any manual "apply-dedupe" actions: {actor, mode, timestamp, applied_delta_estimate}.

infra-oncall: operational constraints: dedupe_pass is CPU-heavy (full-table scan in some partitions). We should gate auto-apply by cluster_headroom > 25% and by quota budget for backfills. Console should grey the "apply" button if budget < estimated_cost.

priya: cost-estimate calc: estimated_compute_units = duplicated_keys * avg_dedupe_cost_per_key. Expose that in expanded view and an "apply_dry_run" that runs a reconcile in shadow mode and surfaces exactly how many rows changed.

replay-bot: sample reconcile output from staging run:
```
staging-run rb-0xa9-shadow: duplicates_found: 61234
shadow_changes: 59200 rows -> predicted delta in MAU: -1.2%
estimated_compute_units: 320 CU
```

sahil: runbook snippet to kick off a preview: 
```bash
# preview dedupe in shadow mode, output sample diff to /tmp/diff.json
replayctl dedupe --job rb-0xa9 --mode dry-run --sample 100 --out /tmp/diff.json
```

lena: question: if we run dedupe-preview and it shows big negative deltas, do we hold the reprocess or do we apply a partial dedupe?

devon: propose two-stage: 1) dry-run preview and publish preview_delta_pct to console; 2) operator decides: hold / partial-apply-by-segment / full-apply. Partial-apply allowed only if cluster_headroom and cost budget pass.

priya: partial-apply by shard-range sounds right. Add an API param --shard-range and the console should provide a small UI to pick hot segments (we can show heatmap).

infra-oncall: also add caps: max_dedupe_concurrency = 4 per-cluster and max_auto_apply_attempts = 1. If operator triggers apply and it fails, surface clear rollback guidance.

replay-bot: job rb-0xa9 ledger: 
```
- 1767777777: precommit_scan DONE (actor: replayctl)
- 1767777790: preview_dedupe requested (actor: lena)
```

sahil: alerting thresholds: slack_warn at duplicate_key_fraction >= 0.01 for > 10m; pager if >= 0.05 for > 5m. That puts this incident in warning territory and not yet a pager (we're at 0.045).

lena: UI: add a compact "dup-risk" chip next to progress, tooltip shows thresholds and estimated delta. Also add an "open preview" modal with sample diffs and a cost bar.

devon: API tweak: job_metadata.preview_url should be populated after dry-run so product can link directly. Also job_metadata.dedupe_mode_history = list of short ledger ids.

priya: operational note: ensure we run the dedupe-preview against a snapshot (consistent read) to avoid mismatch between preview and apply. Otherwise the apply could produce different results.

infra-oncall: agree. use snapshot-timestamp param and include it in ledger entries: snapshot_ts=2026-03-21T09:00:00Z style.

lena: action items: 1) backend: add duplicate_key_fraction to job status and preview endpoint + ledger events (priya + devon) 2) console: dup-risk chip, preview modal, apply UI (sahil) 3) runbook: add dedupe-preview/apply commands and caps to runbook (infra-oncall) 4) alerts: add slack/pager thresholds (priya). ETA: wire draft PRs by EOD tomorrow.

priya: I'll own wiring the slack warn + pager rules.

sahil: I'll prototype the UI modal with a heatmap and cost bar. Will use the staging preview_url from API.

devon: decision: do NOT run auto-apply for this job by default. we'll run a dry-run preview, present to PMs, then decide per-shard apply only if delta acceptable.

lena: will notify #product and link staging preview when available. keep the job in PREPARED until we finish the dedupe decision.

replay-bot: update: preview_dedupe job started (shadow) -> eta ~ 18m

infra-oncall: final note: if multiple reprocess jobs hit similar dupe patterns, we should consider a systemic ingest fix instead of repeated dedupe work. raise an ingest ticket if we see same shard clusters > 3 times in 24h.

devon: thanks all — ping me on thread if you need the preview samples. :white_check_mark:
